# מאגר אופק חדש — Ofek Hadash legal corpus

> The collective agreements, ministry circulars, salary tables and service regulations that determine an Israeli teacher's pay, each encoded as Akoma Ntoso 3.0 (OASIS LegalDocML) and published here in full text with its citation.

284 documents. Every page is one instrument's own wording. There is no advice layer: where the law is silent this corpus says so rather than filling the gap, and an answer drawn from it should quote the clause and name the instrument.

## What is here

- **חוזרים** (circular): 205
- **הסכמים קיבוציים** (collectiveAgreement): 38
- **טבלאות שכר** (salaryTable): 32
- **תקנון שירות עובדי הוראה** (takanon): 7
- **חוקים** (act): 2

## Machine surfaces

This site is readable at the data layer, not only as HTML:

- [corpus.json](https://morimovilimcatala.github.io/ofek-hadash-corpus/corpus.json) — a manifest of every document (path, title, kind, date, FRBR work URI, html and xml hrefs) plus corpus metadata. Start here to enumerate the corpus.
- [ontology.json](https://morimovilimcatala.github.io/ofek-hadash-corpus/ontology.json) — every entity the corpus names (person, organization, role, concept, location) as JSON-LD/SKOS concepts, with its TLC URI and the documents that name it. The machine twin of ontology.html.
- Each document page links its **raw Akoma Ntoso XML** via `<link rel="alternate" type="application/xml">` (and a visible link); the XML sits beside the HTML at the same path with a .xml suffix.
- Each document page carries a schema.org `Legislation` object in a `<script type="application/ld+json">`.
- Inline marks in the HTML carry their encoding as `data-refers-to`, `data-normalized` and `data-eid` attributes, so the ontology graph is recoverable from the rendered page without the XML.

## How the text was obtained

Each document records, in its own XML, how its text was recovered — read directly from a word-processor file, transcribed by reading a scan, extracted from a PDF, or taken from a hand-verified CSV. A PDF-extracted text is bidi-damaged in places and says so. Nothing is OCR: on these scans OCR returns text too corrupt to stand as the wording of an instrument.

## Caveats

- The /akn/il/... identifiers are a repository convention. Israel has no official Akoma Ntoso namespace, and they are not citable outside this corpus.
- A transcription made by a single reader is marked as such and is not the same as a verified one.
- Where a source scan is missing pages, the gap is recorded in place rather than closed.

- [Sitemap](https://morimovilimcatala.github.io/ofek-hadash-corpus/sitemap.xml)
